scope: Separate instrumented ordinary release build of the selected source, without compiler PGO. It is compared against the selected generic executable, not against PGO latency.

method.coarse_phases: Measured every request. Parent run_race_total and request_total are reported separately from their children and must not be added to them.
method.solver_teardown: Derived as run_race_total minus solver_build, runtime_setup, simulation_total, results and replay_objects.
method.sampled_phases: Raw nested timer readings for one tick in 32 with rotating offsets. No current timer-overhead calibration or precision adjustment was performed. These are not full-race phase costs; no scaling or normalization is applied.
method.worker_total: From after request input read through reply cleanup; excludes input read and instrumentation report emission.
